lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I haven't had much time to set this all up,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but I think it's working. Haha.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: It was just getting rather suffocating in here,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: so I decided to head out for some sun.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I mean, I'm on the surface, right? So I might as well enjoy it!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Anyway, it wasn't long before I ran into a Rapture,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: so I scurried back into the bunker right away.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Thankfully, it's not following me anymore,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but it doesn't take a genius to figure out what will happen next ^__^|||

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: If anything happens to me,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I just wanted to say this.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Thank you for checking up on me,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: and thank you for asking me if I wanted to return.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I've been working ever since I was 10,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: and not once did anyone take the time to ask me whether

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I was okay

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: or how I was feeling.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Not once.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Well, at least I've had the chance to meet you,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: so it's not all bad, right?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I hope we can be friends for a long time.
